lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Industry Minister Mélanie Joly is set to hold a four-way meeting today with automaker Stellantis and the union representing more than 9,000 workers, The Canadian Press reports.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after his affair raises national security concerns, The Associated Press reports.
5 people are shot in DC, including 1 killed at a gym, and then suspect kills himself, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
